title.narrative: Support to the Africa-led movement to end female genital mutilation (FGM): technical support

description.narrative: Output 1: Structured package of support to communities: targeted interventionsOutput 2: Small-grants to build the capacity of grassroots women’s, girl-led, women’s rights and youth-led organisations and activistsOutput 3: Integrating end-FGM interventions into existing development programmesOutput 4: Strategic use of media and campaignsOutput 5: Global Advocacy – increased commitment to ending FGM at all levels.

The approach has two interlinked strategies: community-based, and accelerating and scaling. These sit within an overarching learning and adaptive programming approach. Funds flow to participating organisations through a grants mechanism managed by the consortium. Youth and women’s rights organisations are a core success factor in reducing FGM and other forms of violence, yet only a small fraction of gender equality development funding reaches these groups. Grants will help finance both community-based initiatives and the roles that these groups might play in the accelerating and scaling strategy.
